ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-15-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, VJ: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Laura Martinez.
Petitioner: Maeodis Taylor, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Erika rashida Avery, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Erika Rashida Avery-Taylor.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-10-2007 Reset To May-15-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor (by Guardian).
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patricia VanSteenberge.
Petitioner: Maeodis Taylor, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for and the Minor: erika Avery, was sworn and examined.
Proof of Service on notice to the minor's father: Jeffery Avery, received in court, ruled a defective service process.
Matter is continued to May 15, 2007 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to file an Amended OSC. and reserve the notice to Mr. Avery of the new OSC date.
The Court waived republication requirement.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
